# Objetivo

Auditar la consistencia entre **Biogeme** y **Larch** para el modelo interanual enriquecido, priorizando:

1. comparabilidad real de la muestra y la especificación;
2. estabilidad de coeficientes entre frameworks;
3. identificación de parámetros frágiles o con cambio de signo.

::: {.callout-note}
Este notebook no asume de entrada que uno de los dos frameworks “está bien”.

La lectura correcta es:
- si ambos usan la misma muestra y la misma especificación, un `MNL` bien alineado debería dar coeficientes bastante parecidos;
- si no pasa, hay que distinguir entre:
  - diferencia de muestra,
  - diferencia de implementación,
  - o especificación débilmente identificada.
:::

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")


def load_sample_summary(path: Path, *, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not path.exists():
        return pd.DataFrame([{"label": label, "exists": False}])
    df = read_parquet_portable(str(path)).select([pl.col(c) for c in AUDIT_NUMERIC_COLUMNS if c in pl.scan_parquet(str(path)).collect_schema().names()]).collect()
    counts = df.group_by("choice_nested").len().sort("choice_nested").to_dicts()
    out = {
        "label": label,
        "exists": True,
        "rows": df.height,
        "choice_counts": counts,
    }
    for c in [x for x in AUDIT_NUMERIC_COLUMNS if x != "choice_nested" and x in df.columns]:
        out[f"{c}_mean"] = float(df.select(pl.col(c).mean()).item())
        out[f"{c}_std"] = float(df.select(pl.col(c).std()).item())
    return pd.DataFrame([out])


def normalize_param_name(name: str, partition: str = MODEL_PARTITION) -> str:
    s = str(name)
    s = s.replace(f"_{partition}", "")
    return s


def load_params_generic(path: Path, *, framework: str) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    name_col = "Param" if "Param" in df.columns else "Name" if "Name" in df.columns else None
    if name_col is None:
        raise ValueError(f"No se encontró columna Param/Name en {path}")
    value_col = "Value"
    if value_col not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"No se encontró columna Value en {path}")
    p_col = "Robust p-value" if "Robust p-value" in df.columns else "Rob. p-value" if "Rob. p-value" in df.columns else None
    t_col = "Robust t-stat." if "Robust t-stat." in df.columns else "Rob. t-test" if "Rob. t-test" in df.columns else None
    out = df[[name_col, value_col] + ([p_col] if p_col else []) + ([t_col] if t_col else [])].copy()
    out = out.rename(columns={name_col: "param_raw", value_col: "value"})
    out["param"] = out["param_raw"].map(normalize_param_name)
    out["framework"] = framework
    return out


def params_path_for(framework: str, model_name: str) -> Path:
    base = BIOGEME_RESULTS_DIR if framework == "biogeme" else LARCH_RESULTS_DIR
    return base / f"params_{model_name}.csv"


def stats_path_for(framework: str, model_name: str) -> Path:
    base = BIOGEME_RESULTS_DIR if framework == "biogeme" else LARCH_RESULTS_DIR
    return base / f"stats_{model_name}.csv"


def compare_param_tables(df_bio: pd.DataFrame, df_larch: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    comp = (
        df_bio[["param", "value"]].rename(columns={"value": "biogeme_value"})
        .merge(
            df_larch[["param", "value"]].rename(columns={"value": "larch_value"}),
            on="param",
            how="inner",
        )
    )
    comp["abs_diff"] = (comp["biogeme_value"] - comp["larch_value"]).abs()
    denom = (comp["biogeme_value"].abs() + comp["larch_value"].abs()) / 2
    comp["rel_diff_pct"] = np.where(denom > 0, comp["abs_diff"] / denom * 100, np.nan)
    bio_sign = np.sign(comp["biogeme_value"])
    larch_sign = np.sign(comp["larch_value"])
    comp["sign_flip"] = (bio_sign != 0) & (larch_sign != 0) & (bio_sign != larch_sign)
    return comp.sort_values(["sign_flip", "rel_diff_pct"], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)


def summarize_param_stability(comp: pd.DataFrame, *, model_key: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if comp.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame([{"model_key": model_key, "n_common_params": 0}])
    return pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "model_key": model_key,
                "n_common_params": int(len(comp)),
                "n_sign_flips": int(comp["sign_flip"].sum()),
                "pct_sign_flips": round(float(comp["sign_flip"].mean() * 100), 2),
                "mean_abs_diff": float(comp["abs_diff"].mean()),
                "median_abs_diff": float(comp["abs_diff"].median()),
                "mean_rel_diff_pct": float(comp["rel_diff_pct"].dropna().mean()),
                "median_rel_diff_pct": float(comp["rel_diff_pct"].dropna().median()),
                "params_rel_diff_gt_10pct": int((comp["rel_diff_pct"] > 10).sum()),
            }
        ]
    )


def load_stats_frame(path: Path, *, framework: str) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    if {"metric", "value"}.issubset(df.columns):
        return df.assign(framework=framework)
    if len(df) == 1:
        return df.T.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "metric", 0: "value"}).assign(framework=framework)
    return df


def get_metric_value(stats_df: pd.DataFrame | None, candidates: list[str]) -> float | None:
    if stats_df is None or stats_df.empty or "metric" not in stats_df.columns:
        return None
    for key in candidates:
        row = stats_df[stats_df["metric"] == key]
        if not row.empty:
            try:
                return float(row.iloc[0]["value"])
            except Exception:
                return None
    return None


def baseline_manual_loglike(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    params: dict[str, float],
) -> float:
    def p(name: str) -> float:
        return float(params[name])

    v_bip = (
        p("B_BIP_T_VEH") * df["TVH_BIP"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI") * df["TEI_BIP"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB") * df["TET_BIP"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_BIP_N_TRASB") * df["NTR_BIP"].to_numpy()
    )

    v_red = (
        p("ASC_QR_RED")
        + p("B_QR_RED_LAB_PM") * df["DUMMY_LAB_PM"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_LAB_PT") * df["DUMMY_LAB_PT"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_NO_LAB") * df["DUMMY_NO_LAB"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025") * df["DUMMY_ANIO_2025"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND") * df["LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY") * df["LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT") * df["LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT") * df["LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_T_VEH") * df["TVH_QR_RED"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI") * df["TEI_QR_RED"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB") * df["TET_QR_RED"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_RED_N_TRASB") * df["NTR_QR_RED"].to_numpy()
    )

    v_other = (
        p("ASC_QR_OTHER")
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM") * df["DUMMY_LAB_PM"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT") * df["DUMMY_LAB_PT"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB") * df["DUMMY_NO_LAB"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025") * df["DUMMY_ANIO_2025"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND") * df["LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY") * df["LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT") * df["LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT") * df["LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH") * df["TVH_QR_OTHER"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI") * df["TEI_QR_OTHER"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB") * df["TET_QR_OTHER"].to_numpy()
        + p("B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB") * df["NTR_QR_OTHER"].to_numpy()
    )

    vmax = np.maximum.reduce([v_bip, v_red, v_other])
    logsum = vmax + np.log(
        np.exp(v_bip - vmax) + np.exp(v_red - vmax) + np.exp(v_other - vmax)
    )

    choice = df["choice_nested"].to_numpy()
    chosen_v = np.where(choice == 0, v_bip, np.where(choice == 1, v_red, v_other))
    return float(np.sum(chosen_v - logsum))
```

## 6) Cross-Framework Stability Summary

```{python}
#| label: cross-framework-stability-summary
print("label: cross-framework-stability-summary")

stability_rows = []
param_comparisons = {}

for model_key, names in MODEL_REGISTRY.items():
    bio_params = load_params_generic(params_path_for("biogeme", names["biogeme"]), framework="biogeme")
    larch_params = load_params_generic(params_path_for("larch", names["larch"]), framework="larch")
    if bio_params is None or larch_params is None:
        continue
    comp = compare_param_tables(bio_params, larch_params)
    param_comparisons[model_key] = comp
    stability_rows.append(summarize_param_stability(comp, model_key=model_key))

if stability_rows:
    display(pd.concat(stability_rows, ignore_index=True).sort_values(["n_sign_flips", "median_rel_diff_pct"], ascending=[False, False]))
else:
    print("⚠️ No hay modelos con resultados presentes en ambos frameworks.")
```

## 10) Stats Snapshot

```{python}
#| label: stats-snapshot
print("label: stats-snapshot")

stats_rows = []
for model_key, names in MODEL_REGISTRY.items():
    for fw in ["biogeme", "larch"]:
        stats_df = load_stats_frame(stats_path_for(fw, names[fw]), framework=fw)
        if stats_df is None or stats_df.empty:
            continue
        value_map = dict(zip(stats_df["metric"], stats_df["value"]))
        stats_rows.append(
            {
                "model_key": model_key,
                "framework": fw,
                "sample_size": value_map.get("Sample size"),
                "final_ll": value_map.get("Final log likelihood") or value_map.get("Log Likelihood at Convergence | Aggregate"),
                "rho": value_map.get("Rho-square for the init. model") or value_map.get("Rho Squared w.r.t. Null Parameters | Aggregate"),
                "gradient": value_map.get("Final gradient norm"),
            }
        )
if stats_rows:
    display(pd.DataFrame(stats_rows).sort_values(["model_key", "framework"]))
else:
    print("⚠️ No se pudieron cargar stats comparables.")
```

## 11) Manual LL Check For Baseline

```{python}
#| label: baseline-manual-ll-check
print("label: baseline-manual-ll-check")

baseline_bio_params = load_params_generic(
    params_path_for("biogeme", MODEL_REGISTRY["baseline"]["biogeme"]),
    framework="biogeme",
)
baseline_larch_params = load_params_generic(
    params_path_for("larch", MODEL_REGISTRY["baseline"]["larch"]),
    framework="larch",
)
baseline_bio_stats = load_stats_frame(
    stats_path_for("biogeme", MODEL_REGISTRY["baseline"]["biogeme"]),
    framework="biogeme",
)
baseline_larch_stats = load_stats_frame(
    stats_path_for("larch", MODEL_REGISTRY["baseline"]["larch"]),
    framework="larch",
)

if baseline_bio_params is None or baseline_larch_params is None:
    print("⚠️ Faltan params baseline para el chequeo manual.")
else:
    baseline_df = (
        read_parquet_portable(str(BIOGEME_SAMPLE_PATH))
        .select([pl.col(c).cast(pl.Float64) for c in AUDIT_NUMERIC_COLUMNS])
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    bio_map = dict(zip(baseline_bio_params["param"], baseline_bio_params["value"]))
    larch_map = dict(zip(baseline_larch_params["param"], baseline_larch_params["value"]))

    manual_ll_bio = baseline_manual_loglike(baseline_df, bio_map)
    manual_ll_larch = baseline_manual_loglike(baseline_df, larch_map)

    reported_ll_bio = get_metric_value(baseline_bio_stats, ["Final log likelihood"])
    reported_ll_larch = get_metric_value(
        baseline_larch_stats,
        ["Log Likelihood at Convergence | Aggregate"],
    )

    display(
        pd.DataFrame(
            [
                {
                    "framework": "biogeme_params_on_same_sample",
                    "reported_ll": reported_ll_bio,
                    "manual_ll": manual_ll_bio,
                    "abs_diff": None if reported_ll_bio is None else abs(manual_ll_bio - reported_ll_bio),
                },
                {
                    "framework": "larch_params_on_same_sample",
                    "reported_ll": reported_ll_larch,
                    "manual_ll": manual_ll_larch,
                    "abs_diff": None if reported_ll_larch is None else abs(manual_ll_larch - reported_ll_larch),
                },
            ]
        )
    )
```

## 12) Reading Guide

```{python}
#| label: reading-guide
print("label: reading-guide")
print(
    '''
Cómo leer esta auditoría:

1. Si `BIOGEME_SAMPLE_TAG != LARCH_SAMPLE_TAG`, la comparación mezcla efecto-framework con efecto-muestra.
2. `n_sign_flips` alto en baseline es una alerta fuerte.
3. `median_rel_diff_pct` es más útil que `mean_rel_diff_pct` para no dejarse dominar por pocos outliers.
4. Si un modelo parsimonioso tiene menos flips y menor diferencia relativa que el full, eso sugiere mejor identificación.
5. La decisión no debería basarse en "quién gana", sino en qué especificaciones son más estables entre frameworks y muestras.
'''
)
```
